Talk to O'aka a second time and he will ask you if his prices are too expensive. 'Too pricey.' decreases his prices by 25%, 'Just right.' leaves the prices unchanged, and 'Too cheap.' increases his prices by 25%. Listed are the base prices.

These prices are affected by the answer you gave O'aka in Macalania Woods, regarding his prices: 'Too pricey.': -25%; 'Just right.': unchanged; 'Too cheap.': +25%. If you didn't speak to him a second time earlier, these prices will be at their most expensive by default. Listed are the base prices.
